GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5.notes: zod <4.6.6 memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections. Added 2026-11-02. The production copy is FIXED (zod 4.4.3 to 4.6.7); this entry is for the one remaining copy, zod@3.25.76, dev-only via @lhci/cli > lighthouse > puppeteer-core@24.43.1 > chromium-bidi@14.0.0, which declares zod ^3.24.1. 3.25.76 is the latest 3.x release, so no patched version exists in the range its parent accepts, and forcing zod 4 under it would swap the API it was built against. Only Lighthouse CI loads it, against our own pages. Drop it once a @lhci/cli release reaches a chromium-bidi that uses zod 4.
